claims.subject: project system
claims.allowed_zh: 本项目由独立玩家产品、自动玩家、工具与语义基础设施、证据与发行共同构成。
claims.allowed_en: The project combines player products, an autonomous player, semantic tooling, evidence and release.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not claim that every component is fully automated or complete.

claims.subject: Eternal Recurrence
claims.allowed_zh: 旗舰产品提供契约、祝福与诅咒、死亡计分和跨存档余烬循环。
claims.allowed_en: The flagship provides contracts, blessings and curses, death settlement and cross-save embers.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not imply that a single recorded character demonstrates every contract or an uninterrupted natural lifetime.

claims.subject: Vivhite Courtier
claims.allowed_zh: 白绮特供版独立完成廷臣配置、计价、创建与交付。
claims.allowed_en: The Vivhite edition independently configures, prices, creates and delivers a courtier.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not attribute recurrence, contracts or cross-save state to the standalone edition.

claims.subject: ZhongGuo 361 public product
claims.allowed_zh: 天朝 361 的公开能力包含京察、绩效榜、强制分布、PIP、晋升和政策卡。
claims.allowed_en: The public ZhongGuo 361 scope includes review, scoreboards, forced distribution, PIP, promotion and policy cards.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not show or describe unpublished Phase 2, and do not call 361 policy cards 361 complete minigames.

claims.subject: independent mod portfolio
claims.allowed_zh: 牛来、体验优化、自动升级建筑、重整河山、肃清曼荼罗伪信和驱策朝贡国保持独立产品与发布边界。
claims.allowed_en: The smaller mods retain independent product and release boundaries.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not claim that a matrix montage proves every complete gameplay loop.

claims.subject: coat-of-arms editor
claims.allowed_zh: 家徽编辑器在浏览器中解析、编辑、拟合并确定性序列化 CK3 家徽。
claims.allowed_en: The browser tool parses, edits, fits and deterministically serializes CK3 coats of arms.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: The production web page does not connect to CK3 or provide arbitrary script execution.

claims.subject: CK3 autonomous player
claims.allowed_zh: 自动玩家已经在受证明的有界场景中完成观察、决策、动作、后置验证与持久 checkpoint。
claims.allowed_en: The agent has completed observation, decision, action, postcondition verification and durable checkpoints in proven bounded scenes.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not claim complete CK3 autonomy, all-domain coverage or consumer readiness.

claims.subject: document and generator workflow
claims.allowed_zh: 权威文档和结构化数据通过生成器投影为脚本、GUI、本地化、测试与文档。
claims.allowed_en: Authoritative documents and structured data are projected into scripts, UI, localization, tests and documentation.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not claim that all project content is generated from one universal schema.

claims.subject: MCP, native bridge and OCR boundaries
claims.allowed_zh: 结构化原生状态优先承担真值；OCR 只核对玩家可见呈现或在缺少原生能力时临时观测。
claims.allowed_en: Typed native state is the source of truth; OCR verifies visible presentation or temporarily fills an observation gap.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not present OCR as authoritative hidden state or MCP as an unrestricted production back door.

claims.subject: release and Workshop verification
claims.allowed_zh: 正式构建使用 allowlist 生成 staging、manifest 与可复现 ZIP；已发布产品还执行线上回读。
claims.allowed_en: Release builders create allowlisted staging, manifests and reproducible ZIPs; published products also use online readback.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: Do not imply that every product is automatically uploaded or that all Workshop channels share one readiness state.

claims.subject: project principles
claims.allowed_zh: 文档先行，文档高于测试，测试高于代码；真实状态高于成功回执。
claims.allowed_en: Documentation precedes tests, tests precede code, and true state outranks success receipts.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: This ordering does not excuse stale documentation; conflicts must be corrected at the authoritative layer.

claims.subject: four infinite loops
claims.allowed_zh: 四个 Loop 是项目最终目标和演进模型。
claims.allowed_en: The four loops are the project's target system and evolution model.
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: Never present the complete four-loop target as already achieved; keep VISION / TARGET SYSTEM on screen.
